we have developed a graphical decision aid for placement of elderly people to long-term care.

a) a composite model comprising of syndromic decision rule and a two-stage hierarchical regression model can be used for the prediction of placement outcomes; and, b) a graphical decision aid based on this model can help in the decision making process for placement of the elderly in long-term care.
a graphical decision aid based on the triangle plot can be used as a tool for the placement of the elderly in a residential home or a nursing home in a London borough.

the development of a graphical decision support tool to aid placement of the elderly in long-term care.
developing and evaluating decision aids for the management of health care.
the use of decision support systems in health and social care.

this paper provides a useful and practical tool that could be used in the decision making process for placement of elderly people into long-term care.

a decision aid can help in the placement of older people into long-term care.
